    pid = playlist['playlist_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    song_ids = [song['id'] for song in details['songs']]
    playlist_songs[pid] = song_ids
    for song in details['songs']:
        if song['id'] not in all_songs:
            all_songs[song['id']] = song  # store basic info, we'll enrich later

steps.code:
# Parse the old songs file content
old_songs_entries = []
for line in old_songs_file['content'].split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs_entries.append({'title': title, 'artists': set(artists)})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs_entries)} old songs entries")
for entry in old_songs_entries:
    print(f"  {entry['title']} by {entry['artists']}")
